free_text: Deferring is appropriate because the patient has a prior positive biopsy confirming low-grade disease, meaning the tissue diagnosis is already established. Although the PSA trend is rising and the PI-RADS is 3 with an elevated PSA density of 0.25, the prior histological confirmation provides sufficient characterization to guide management. The combination of these factors does not necessitate a repeat biopsy to change the established treatment pathway.
